thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Sev2 - Inference runtime pool us-west-2 reporting elevated 5xx rate (~3.2%). Triggered at 1778881111. Paging alice (oncall).

alice: Ack, I'm on it. Looking at the console now.

alice: Initial checks - routing shows spillover to fallback-model-v2, latency up, and increased retries. Receiving customer error reports in #support.

ben: grabbing logs and request ids. Looks like KV cache eviction errors causing repeated reloads and OOM on some nodes.

alice: Mitigating: disabling auto-burst on the pool to stop oversubscription.

alice: Command I'm running: 
```
curl -X POST https://ops.console/api/pools/us-west-2/actions \
  -d '{"action":"set_burst","value":false}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

alice: Also initiating a canary rollback to runtime v1.3 to stop the 5xx spike.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback started by alice at 1778881200. ETA ~7m.

carol: Product: prepping a short customer note. Will wait till we confirm impact window and percent affected.

alice: Confirming 5xx rate dropping to ~1.1% after rollback. Continuing to monitor.

ben: Root cause hypothesis: memory leak in runtime v1.4 under certain long-sequence workloads leading to repeated restarts. Collecting mem profiles.

dave: (security) Noted — we need to preserve logs/evidence for audit. Please snapshot affected instances and upload to secure bucket. I'll open an evidence ticket.

emma: Ops: creating snapshots now. Snapshot IDs: snap-0a1b2c3d. Uploading logs with KMS encryption.

emma: Commands used: 
```
aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id vol-abc123 --description "incident 1778881111"
aws s3 cp /var/log/runtime/* s3://redwood-incidents/1778881111/ --acl private --sse aws:kms
```

sam: Collecting core dumps and checksums: 
```
tar czf /tmp/1778881111-coredumps.tar.gz /var/crash/*
sha256sum /tmp/1778881111-coredumps.tar.gz > /tmp/1778881111.sha256
```

alice: Handoff note: I'm heading off shift in 30m. Ben will be primary owner for follow-ups and post-incident tracking.

ben: Got it. I'll run memprof against canary traffic and open a reproducible ticket with traces.

carol: Draft customer message: "We've observed elevated errors affecting inference requests in us-west-2 between 11:12-11:45 UTC; service restored after rollback. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem." Preview: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incident-1778881111/triage

dave: Security follow-up: I see a gap in our KMS access logging for the exact window. Adding to action items: preserve whatever logs we have, and escalate to infra for KMS logging fix.

alice: Action items (summary):
  1) ben: reproduce & root-cause + patch.
  2) emma/ops: ensure snapshots + all logs uploaded and checksummed.
  3) dave/security: preserve audit trail, collect evidence, validate KMS access logs and file SEC ticket.
  4) carol/product: customer comms + coordinate postmortem scheduling.
  5) alice: postmortem facilitator and notes.

incident-bot: postmortem-scheduler: Proposed postmortem meeting Thu 14:30 UTC. Invite sent to oncall, SRE, Eng, Security, Product, Legal.

ben: Note — one runtime node's trace appears missing; logrotate removed a file before snapshot. Adding "prevent logrotate during incident" to the action tracker.

dave: For compliance, we need chain-of-custody metadata: checksums, uploader identity, and access logs. Emma, please add checksums and lock down bucket ACLs; then share the secure link with SEC-4321. Also consider rotating the KMS key used for those snapshots per policy.

emma: Will do. Running: 
```
aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket redwood-incidents --policy file://incident-lock.json
aws s3 cp /tmp/1778881111-coredumps.tar.gz s3://redwood-incidents/1778881111/ --metadata sha256=$(cat /tmp/1778881111.sha256) --sse aws:kms
```

sam: I'll open a PR to add a runtime guardrail: disable auto-burst when memory pressure > 80% and fail fast with better telemetry.

carol: Postmortem doc (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/postmortem/1778881111. Action tracker: https://linear.redwood.ai/boards/infra/incident-1778881111

alice: Leaving handoff now — Ben is taking over. Ping me if anything regresses. :wave: 

ben: Acknowledged. I'll own reproducibility and the patch proposal; will update the tracker by EOD.

security-bot: audit-log-bot: KMS access anomaly detected for 1778881111 timeframe. Created ticket SEC-4321.

dave: Added SEC-4321 to action items and looping in Compliance for evidence retention windows (requested 7 years per regs).

carol: Postmortem meeting confirmed Thu 14:30 UTC. Legal and Security are on the invite.

alice: Final operational note: preliminary customer impact assessment — approx 12% of inference pipelines in us-west-2 saw errors during the window, but most requests retried successfully. We'll include exact metrics in the postmortem.

ben: Updating action tracker now, will tag owners and due dates.

emma: All evidence uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1778881111/ with KMS encryption and checksums. Bucket ACLs tightened.

dave: Security will prepare an evidence bundle and formal chain-of-custody for Compliance.

carol: Thanks everyone — big props for quick mitigation. We'll run the postmortem and track remediation to completion. :thumbsup:

End of thread.
